name: research
title: Research
description: Deep research in the background on a question: Octipus's research agent searches the web and your knowledge, reads the sources and writes a cited report, which you can save to your documents.

start_research.description: Start deep research on a question in the background (a run of Octipus's research agent, as the user); returns its run id

research_status.description: Read a research run: its status, stage and, once done, the cited report

save_report.description: Save a finished research report as a document of the user's, or update the one saved before
